# Project Rules

- Never invent my qualifications, experience, jobs, salaries, or sponsorship data. Label all demo data "Demo".
- Never auto-submit applications or auto-publish LinkedIn posts.
- Never delete saved data. Migrate old localStorage data safely.
- Wrap every localStorage read in try/catch. Never use `.map`, `.filter`, or `.length` on data that could be undefined.
- Change one feature at a time. Do not rewrite working files.
- Keep the app iPad-friendly: 44px touch targets, no hover-only actions, portrait and landscape layouts.
- If a step fails, read the error, fix it, and retry up to 3 times. If still blocked, explain it in simple words.
- Ask permission only before deleting files or pushing to GitHub.
